content.short: Building decentralized toolsets and making it easy to spin up a DAO on Cardano. Our motto is “Decentralization Together".
content.description:
ADAO is a Service DAO dedicated to providing Public Goods that would be useful for all stakeholders of the Cardano network who are interested in using decentralized toolsets on the blockchain. Starting with a few people chatting in Twitter spaces, ADAO has grown into a community of hundreds of individuals on our Discord server and over a dozen core contributors who are excited about the potential that on-chain governance brings to the community.

The members of ADAO seek to serve the Cardano community in three main areas: First, we share knowledge about what DAOs are and how to use them effectively. Second, we develop tools to support decentralized coordination and DAO governance on the blockchain. Third, we offer technical, organizational, and financial support in designing and developing DAOs.

Our goal is to make sure everyone has an opportunity to contribute to the success of the organization by sharing their unique talents and skills. There are plenty of tasks needed to improve.

We invite anyone interested to join a Working Group, find a bounty that they would be able to fulfill, or come to one of our meetings to ask what work needs to be done. You can find more information about ADAO by visiting our website, which contains links to all of our social media accounts and the Discord server where we coordinate our activities.
